missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Год' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'прошёл'. 'Целый' agrees in the masculine, stressing the full span of time.

missions.phrase: Я жду этот год с нетерпением.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Год' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'жду', matching the nominative form. 'С нетерпением' is the instrumental of manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Года' is the genitive after 'начале' to mean the start of the year. 'В начале' is itself a prepositional phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. 'Года' is the genitive singular required after 'три' (numbers two through four). A key rule for counting years.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'К году' uses the dative 'году' after 'к' to mean toward the new year. 'Новому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'С годом' uses the instrumental 'годом' after 'с' in the set phrase meaning year by year. 'Каждым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.

missions.phrase: В этом году я много путешествовал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В году' uses the special prepositional 'году' after 'в' to mean during this year. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: В прошлом году была холодная зима.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В году' again takes the locative 'году' to set the time frame. 'Прошлом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Suppletive plural genitive. The genitive plural of 'год' is the suppletive 'лет', borrowed from 'лето' and required after 'много'. A core irregular form.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Годы' is the nominative plural of 'год', the subject of 'были'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'счастливыми' is the instrumental predicate.
